items.name: LangGraph
items.summary: Stateful multi-actor graphs. Best for cyclical agent loops and human-in-loop.

items.name: AutoGen
items.summary: Microsoft's conversational multi-agent framework. Strong on role specialization.

items.name: CrewAI
items.summary: Role-based agent crews. Easier than LangGraph for simple pipelines.

items.name: LlamaIndex Agents
items.summary: RAG-first agents. Best when your data lives in many file types.

items.name: smolagents (HF)
items.summary: 1k-line code-agent. Minimal surface, max hackability. The HF-native pick.

items.name: PydanticAI
items.summary: Type-safe agent framework. Pydantic everywhere. Great for production.

items.name: MusicNet (AMT)
items.summary: Polyphonic piano + orchestral transcription. The reference AMT eval.

items.name: MUSDB18 (separation)
items.summary: 4-stem source separation. Higher SDR = cleaner stems.

items.name: LibriSpeech (ASR)
items.summary: 960h of public-domain English audiobooks. The default ASR benchmark.

items.name: VBench (T2V)
items.summary: 16-dim video quality eval: subject consistency, motion, aesthetics, etc.

items.name: VCTK (TTS)
items.summary: 110 English speakers, multi-accent. The de-facto zero-shot TTS eval.

items.name: CHiME-6 (diarization)
items.summary: Multi-mic dinner-party recordings. The diarization stress test.
